title: Measure which branches of the original the comparison corpus reaches
scope: Run the original parsers and commands with V8/c8 coverage while the corpus and fuzz cases execute; report original source branches never reached by any comparison case. Each unreached branch is unverified behaviour and becomes a corpus or fuzz target.
acceptance: Report lists, per original source file, lines and branches reached versus not reached by the committed corpus, reproducibly under Node 22.
Unreached branches in ported units are tracked as open items in the unit JSON; the report is generated, not hand-edited.
open_items: Needs a decision on the coverage tool (c8 is already a Node-side dev tool; no product dependency).
